thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate on /v1/embeddings for prod-region-eu (alerts > 5m threshold). Triggered by routing-policy change at 1715999900.

emily: seeing a spike of 500s for embeddings. looks like requests are getting routed to chat runtimes?

priya: confirmed. logs show Content-Type=application/json embed requests hitting runtime 'chat-legacy-v2' which returns schema mismatch and 500.

jason: who pushed the routing policy change? I see an alias pin update to 'model-alias/2024-11-01' about ~8m ago.

marta: customer support inbound: 3 customers (enterprise) report failed batch ingests. ticket ids: #5421 #5423 #5424.

emily: quick mitigation plan: 1) pause alias pin rollout 2) pin back to previous alias 3) route embeddings to fallback-embed-compat variant. Can someone flip the policy?

priya: i can do immediate policy change. moving traffic away from 'chat-legacy-v2' for embedding routes. Executing now.

priya: /remediate routing-policy:set route[type=embed] -> model:embed-compat-quantized pinned=true --dry-run

priya: applied. traffic switch started. watching metrics.

incident-bot: Change detected: routing-policy update by priya at 1716000123.

kevin: FYI the code that does model compatibility check is in runtime-router svc. It should have prevented alias pin if variant types mismatch, wondering why it didn't block.

jason: found the root cause: alias pin referenced a model alias that resolves to a new version where the default variant is 'chat-instruct' but the alias metadata omitted the variant_type tag. router fell through to fallback that maps only by alias -> runtime and not by request-type. Basically missing variant_type in model metadata + permissive fallback logic.

emily: so the pinned version was compatible for gen but not for embed endpoints. that explains 500s.

marta: customer impact note: affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings (prod-eu). error rate peaked ~720 errors/minute for ~6 minutes. approx 1.2k failed requests.

priya: rolling back alias pin now. /deploy revert-alias model-alias/2024-11-01 -> previous: model-alias/2024-10-28

priya: rollback applied at 1716000280. routing now resolves to pre-rollback variant. error rates dropping.

incident-bot: Alert resolved: error rate returned to baseline at 1716000360.

kevin: root mitigation tasks: 1) add variant_type tag enforcement on alias pin updates 2) make router validate request-type -> model-variant compatibility as a hard check, not a soft fallback 3) add a circuit-breaker so embeddings routed to chat variants are rejected instead of hitting runtime.

jason: short-term patch pushed: router will now lookup model.metadata.variant_type and reject alias pin if missing or mismatch for request routes. pushing to staging then prod today.

emily: on-call handoff: i'm taking initial postmortem, priya will own remediation PRs, jason will own infra / router changes. marta to coordinate customer comms.

marta: draft notify: "We experienced a brief disruption to embeddings ingestion in EU. Root cause: a model alias update introduced a variant mismatch causing the routing layer to send embedding requests to a chat runtime. We rolled back the alias and restored normal service within ~6 minutes. We're implementing validation checks and better fallbacks."

priya: can we include an action item to backfill retroactive checks to detect similar alias updates that affected other regions?

jason: yes — add to postmortem: sweep alias updates in the last 24h across regions and list pins with missing variant_type.

emily: customer impact severity: P2 for now (limited customers, short duration). recommending proactive outreach to impacted customers with credits. marta, please coordinate.

marta: will draft emails and post in #customer-notifications after review.

kevin: logging snippet for runbook (copied from runtime logs):
```
2024-11-01T08:01:23Z router.INFO resolved_alias=model-alias/2024-11-01 -> runtime=chat-legacy-v2 metadata.variant_type=null
2024-11-01T08:01:24Z router.WARN request-type=embed routed_to=chat-legacy-v2 -> runtime-error schema-mismatch
2024-11-01T08:01:24Z runtime.ERROR ingest handler: validation failed: expected embed vector response, got chat proto
```

emily: next steps (short):
- Priya: land routing-policy validation PR and hotfix (ETA 2h)
- Jason: infra patch to make variant_type required on alias creation (ETA EOD)
- Kevin: add automated CI check for alias metadata on model-publish (ETA 3d)
- Marta: customer comms draft and credit proposal (ETA 4h)

priya: i'm on the PR now. will ping here when merged.

incident-bot: Incident timeline logged (incident-id: INC-2024-1101-07).

emily: closing the pager thread — continue postmortem work in #postmortems. thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
